should_fix.proposed_change: Author-review the per-unit baseline/proposed actions in unit_statuses; do not apply automatic numeric changes.
should_fix.expected_consequence: Unit changes are reviewed after system-rule findings, avoiding a unit patch that masks a systemic imbalance.

should_fix.proposed_change: Confirm one canonical XP-per-combat and win-bonus contract before balance sign-off.
should_fix.expected_consequence: Future unit and trait measurements are not confounded by an unresolved progression-rate interpretation.

accepted_risks.proposed_change: No active Set 2 change; retain as non-blocking legacy metadata until an author explicitly normalizes it.
accepted_risks.expected_consequence: The active runtime remains on the approved 32-unit/12-trait contract without invented mappings.

accepted_risks.baseline: Controlled same-cost pairwise is primary, while team context is confounded by traits, composition, target selection, and side asymmetry.
accepted_risks.proposed_change: Keep the raw JSON and seeds; repeat after any approved rules or value change.
accepted_risks.expected_consequence: The report remains evidence for author review rather than an automatic balancing authority.
